<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="color-scheme" content="light">
<link rel="icon" href="data:,">
<title>Little Bloom Kit — Paint, Create, Bloom!</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Anton&family=Oswald:wght@200;300;400;500;600&family=Space+Mono:wght@400;700&family=Baloo+2:wght@600;700;800&family=Caveat:wght@700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<noscript><style>.reveal{opacity:1!important}
</style></noscript>
<style>
:root{
  --black:#FFF7FB; --ink:#3D235E; --dim:#7A6A9A;
  --green:#7ED6A5; --deep:#FFE0EC; --deep2:#EFE6FF;
  --yellow:#FFE066; --red:#ff6b6b; --pink:#FF8FAB; --hot:#FF5D8F;
  --plum:#EFE6FF; --paper:#FFF9F0; --purple:#4A2C6B; --lav:#CDB4F0; --sky:#A8D8EA; --peach:#FFC8A2; --mint:#B5EAD7;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{background:var(--black);color:var(--ink);font-family:"Oswald",sans-serif;overflow-x:hidden}
img{display:block;max-width:100%}
button{cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit}
::selection{background:var(--yellow);color:#000}

/* type helpers */
.anton{font-family:"Anton",sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;line-height:.92;letter-spacing:.01em}
.osw-light{font-family:"Oswald",sans-serif;font-weight:200;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em}
.mono{font-family:"Space Mono",monospace;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.14em}
.outline{color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:2.5px #4A2C6B}
.outline-green{color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:2.5px var(--green)}
.outline-thin{color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:1.2px rgba(255,255,255,.85)}

/* ===== KEYFRAMES (100+ animated elements across the page) ===== */
@keyframes floatY{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(var(--r,0deg))}50%{transform:translateY(-16px) rotate(var(--r,0deg))}}
@keyframes wiggle{0%,100%{transform:rotate(-6deg)}50%{transform:rotate(6deg)}}
@keyframes bounceSoft{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}30%{transform:translateY(-13px)}60%{transform:translateY(2px)}}
@keyframes spinSlow{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
@keyframes sway{0%,100%{transform:rotate(-4deg)}50%{transform:rotate(4deg)}}
@keyframes heartbeat{0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}25%{transform:scale(1.22)}45%{transform:scale(.96)}60%{transform:scale(1.13)}}
@keyframes twinkle{0%,100%{opacity:.2;transform:scale(.65) rotate(0deg)}50%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.3) rotate(45deg)}}
@keyframes drift{from{transform:translateX(-14vw)}to{transform:translateX(112vw)}}
@keyframes marquee{from{transform:translateX(0)}to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
@keyframes marqueeRev{from{transform:translateX(-50%)}to{transform:translateX(0)}}
@keyframes letterBounce{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}30%{transform:translateY(-12px) rotate(-3deg)}55%{transform:translateY(2px) rotate(2deg)}}
@keyframes riseIn{from{opacity:0;translate:0 50px}to{opacity:1;translate:0 0}}
@keyframes slideL{from{opacity:0;translate:-60px 0}to{opacity:1;translate:0 0}}
@keyframes slideR{from{opacity:0;translate:60px 0}to{opacity:1;translate:0 0}}
@keyframes popIn{from{opacity:0;scale:.6;translate:0 26px}to{opacity:1;scale:1;translate:0 0}}
@keyframes balloonUp{0%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(-3deg)}100%{transform:translateY(-112vh) rotate(5deg)}}
@keyframes liquidShift{0%,100%{transform:translateX(0) scale(1.05)}50%{transform:translateX(-2.5%) scale(1.12)}}
@keyframes domeGlow{0%,100%{filter:brightness(1)}50%{filter:brightness(1.14)}}
@keyframes hueDrift{0%,100%{filter:hue-rotate(0deg) saturate(1.1)}50%{filter:hue-rotate(-14deg) saturate(1.3)}}
@keyframes jelly{0%,100%{transform:scale(1,1)}25%{transform:scale(.93,1.07)}50%{transform:scale(1.07,.93)}75%{transform:scale(.98,1.02)}}
@keyframes pulseRing{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(255,233,61,.55)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 24px rgba(255,233,61,0)}}
@keyframes grainShift{0%{transform:translate(0,0)}25%{transform:translate(-2%,1.5%)}50%{transform:translate(1.5%,-2%)}75%{transform:translate(-1%,-1%)}100%{transform:translate(0,0)}}
@keyframes zoomPulse{0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}50%{transform:scale(1.05)}}

.reveal{opacity:0}
.reveal.in{opacity:1;animation:riseIn .9s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.1) both}
.reveal.pop.in{animation-name:popIn}
.reveal.fromL.in{animation-name:slideL}
.reveal.fromR.in{animation-name:slideR}

/* floating shapes layer */
.sky{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:1;overflow:hidden}
.sky span{position:absolute;opacity:.45;animation:floatY var(--d,5s) ease-in-out infinite;animation-delay:var(--dl,0s)}
.sky .tw{animation:twinkle var(--d,2.6s) ease-in-out infinite;animation-delay:var(--dl,0s)}
.cloud{position:fixed;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;font-size:52px;opacity:.16;animation:drift linear infinite}

/* ============ 1 · HERO ============ */
.hero{position:relative;min-height:100svh;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(ellipse 90% 75% at 50% 42%,#FFF0F6 0%,#FFB6D9 32%,#CDB4F0 62%,#A8D8EA 100%);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.hero-photo{position:relative;z-index:2;width:min(500px,82vw);height:min(74svh,760px);overflow:hidden;animation:zoomPulse 9s ease-in-out infinite}
.hero-photo img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.hero-top{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:5;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;padding:20px 22px}
.hero-top .mono{font-size:11px;color:#4A2C6B;opacity:.92}
.hero-top .ctr{text-align:center}
.hero-top .ctr img{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;margin:0 auto 6px;animation:spinSlow 26s linear infinite}
.hero-word{position:absolute;top:50%;translate:0 -58%;z-index:4;font-size:clamp(74px,17.5vw,264px);color:#4A2C6B;text-shadow:0 8px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.7);white-space:nowrap}
.hero-word .L{display:inline-block;animation:letterBounce 2.6s ease-in-out infinite;animation-delay:calc(var(--i)*.09s)}
.hero-word.left{left:1.5vw;text-align:left}
 .hero-word.right{color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:3px #4A2C6B} .hero-word.right{right:1.5vw;text-align:right}
.hero-label{position:absolute;top:calc(50% + clamp(38px,8.5vw,128px));z-index:4;color:#4A2C6B}
.hero-label .mono{display:block;font-size:clamp(11px,1.5vw,16px)}
.hero-label .mono.big-l{font-size:clamp(13px,1.9vw,21px);font-weight:700;color:#FF5D8F}
.hero-label.left{left:2.2vw}
.hero-label.right{right:2.2vw;text-align:right}
.hero-bottom{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:5;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;padding:20px 22px;gap:16px}
.hero-bottom .mono{font-size:11px;color:#4A2C6B;opacity:.92;max-width:300px;line-height:1.9}
.hero-bottom .caveat{font-family:"Caveat",cursive;font-size:clamp(24px,3.6vw,36px);color:#FF5D8F;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0;animation:sway 4s ease-in-out infinite;display:inline-block}
@media(max-width:640px){
  .hero-word{font-size:clamp(58px,19vw,120px)}
  .hero-word.left{left:0}
   .hero-word.right{color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:3px #4A2C6B} .hero-word.right{right:0}
  .hero-bottom .mono.hideM{display:none}
  .hero-photo{height:62svh}
}

/* thin marquee strip (template edge detail, not a nav) */
.strip{overflow:hidden;background:var(--yellow);padding:8px 0;position:relative;z-index:3}
.strip .track{display:flex;width:max-content;white-space:nowrap;animation:marquee 24s linear infinite;font-family:"Space Mono",monospace;font-weight:700;font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:.18em;color:#141a00;text-transform:uppercase}
.strip .track span{padding:0 16px}
.strip.black{background:#4A2C6B}
.strip.black .track{color:var(--yellow);animation-name:marqueeRev}

/* ============ 2 · BLACK INTRO + WARP + DOME ============ */
.intro{position:relative;background:var(--black);overflow:hidden;padding-bottom:0}
.warp{width:100%;height:clamp(180px,36vh,340px);display:block;animation:hueDrift 10s ease-in-out infinite}
.warp-move{animation:liquidShift 9s ease-in-out infinite;transform-origin:center}
.intro-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:26px;padding:52px 22px 10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.intro-row .anton{font-size:clamp(30px,4.6vw,58px);color:#4A2C6B}
.intro-row .mid{font-size:clamp(30px,4.6vw,58px)}
.intro-row p.mono{font-size:11.5px;line-height:2.05;color:var(--dim);max-width:320px;text-align:right}
.intro-row p.mono b{color:#4A2C6B}
.dome-zone{position:relative;height:clamp(200px,34vw,380px);overflow:hidden;margin-top:26px}
.dome{position:absolute;left:50%;top:8%;translate:-50% 0;width:150vw;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 30%,#FFE066 0%,#FFB6D9 45%,#FF8FAB 78%,#CDB4F0 100%);animation:domeGlow 5.5s ease-in-out infinite}
.dome-txt{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:34%;text-align:center;z-index:2}
.dome-txt .anton{font-size:clamp(44px,9.5vw,138px);color:#4A2C6B}
.dome-txt .mono{font-size:clamp(10px,1.5vw,14px);color:#4A2C6B;font-weight:700}
@media(max-width:760px){.intro-row{flex-direction:column}.intro-row p.mono{text-align:left}}

/* ============ 3 · PICKS IN FOCUS ============ */
.picks{background:var(--plum);position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:0 0 74px}
.picks-circle{width:132vw;max-width:none;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;overflow:hidden;margin:-16vw auto 0;position:relative;left:50%;translate:-50% 0;animation:zoomPulse 12s ease-in-out infinite}
.picks-circle img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.picks-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:28px;padding:44px 22px 0;flex-wrap:wrap}
.picks-row h2{font-family:"Oswald",sans-serif;font-weight:200;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:clamp(38px,6.4vw,84px);line-height:1;color:#4A2C6B;letter-spacing:.04em}
.picks-row h2 b{font-weight:600}
.picks-list{font-family:"Space Mono",monospace;font-size:clamp(11px,1.4vw,14.5px);line-height:2.1;letter-spacing:.14em;color:#5B4B8A;text-transform:uppercase;text-align:right;max-width:430px}
.picks-list span{color:var(--pink)}
@media(max-width:760px){.picks-list{text-align:left}}

/* ============ KIT BANDS — full-bleed photo + giant type, no boxes ============ */
.kitband{position:relative;min-height:82svh;overflow:hidden;display:flex;align-items:flex-end}
.kitband .bgimg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transform:scale(1.02);transition:transform 1.2s ease}
.kitband:hover .bgimg{transform:scale(1.09)}
.kitband .shade{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(to top,rgba(0,0,0,.88) 0%,rgba(0,0,0,.34) 42%,rgba(0,0,0,.08) 70%)}
.kitband .kb-in{position:relative;z-index:2;width:100%;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:24px;padding:0 22px 34px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.kitband h3{font-size:clamp(46px,9.5vw,132px);color:#fff;text-shadow:0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.55)}
.kitband h3 .out{display:block;color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:2.5px #fff}
.kitband .kb-no{font-family:"Space Mono",monospace;color:var(--yellow);font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.2em;margin-bottom:12px;display:block}
.kitband .kb-txt{max-width:360px}
.kitband .kb-txt p{font-family:"Space Mono",monospace;font-size:12px;line-height:2;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#eef3e6}
.kitband .kb-tags{margin-top:14px;font-family:"Space Mono",monospace;font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.16em;color:var(--green);text-transform:uppercase;line-height:2}
.kitband.flip .kb-in{flex-direction:row-reverse;text-align:right}
.kitband.flip .kb-txt{margin-left:auto}
@media(max-width:640px){.kitband{min-height:74svh}}

/* ============ 4 · LIQUID GREEN BAND ============ */
.liquid{position:relative;min-height:92svh;overflow:hidden;background:#FFE0EC}
.liquid svg.liquidbg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%}
.liquid-move{animation:liquidShift 11s ease-in-out infinite;transform-origin:center}
.liquid .liq-in{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:3;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:28px;padding:0 22px 38px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.liquid h2{font-size:clamp(40px,7.6vw,104px);color:#4A2C6B;max-width:640px;text-shadow:0 12px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.liquid h2 .y{color:#FF5D8F}
.liquid .check-mono{font-family:"Space Mono",monospace;font-size:12px;line-height:2.1;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#4A2C6B;margin-top:20px}
.liquid .check-mono i{font-style:normal;color:#FF5D8F;font-weight:700}
.themes-mono{font-family:"Space Mono",monospace;font-size:clamp(11px,1.35vw,14px);line-height:2.15;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#4A2C6B;text-align:right}
.themes-mono button{background:none;border:none;color:inherit;font:inherit;letter-spacing:inherit;text-transform:uppercase;padding:0;display:block;margin-left:auto;transition:.2s;text-align:right;min-height:30px}
.themes-mono button:hover{color:var(--yellow);transform:translateX(-8px)}
.themes-mono .th-head{color:#FF5D8F;font-weight:700}
@media(max-width:760px){.themes-mono{text-align:left}.themes-mono button{margin-left:0;text-align:left}}
.steps-line{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 34px;padding:26px 22px 0;position:relative;z-index:3}
.steps-line .mono{font-size:11.5px;color:#4A2C6B;line-height:2}
.steps-line .mono b{color:#FF5D8F}

/* ============ PAINT PLAYGROUND — full-bleed, no box ============ */
.playground{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#ffe9f3 0%,#fff3cf 38%,#dff7e6 72%,#e6ebff 100%);color:#33200f;position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:74px 0 84px}
.playground .pg-head{padding:0 22px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:24px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.playground h2{font-size:clamp(48px,10vw,140px);color:#241207}
.playground h2 .outd{color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:2.5px #241207;display:block}
.playground .pg-head p.mono{color:#6d4a26;font-size:11.5px;line-height:2.05;max-width:320px;text-align:right}
.palette{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;padding:38px 22px 6px}
.pot{width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;border:4px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 10px 20px rgba(60,30,0,.22);transition:.2s;animation:floatY 3.6s ease-in-out infinite;animation-delay:var(--dl,0s)}
.pot:hover{transform:scale(1.2) rotate(-8deg)}
.pot.sel{outline:4px solid #241207;transform:scale(1.16)}
.shapes-row{display:flex;gap:6vw;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:flex-end;padding:30px 22px 0}
.shapeitem{text-align:center}
.shapeitem svg{width:clamp(120px,17vw,190px);height:auto;cursor:pointer;transition:.3s;filter:drop-shadow(0 14px 18px rgba(60,30,0,.16))}
.shapeitem svg:hover{transform:scale(1.09) rotate(-2.5deg)}
.shapeitem small{display:block;font-family:"Caveat",cursive;font-size:23px;color:#b03a72;margin-top:6px}
.pg-btns{display:flex;gap:0;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:36px 22px 0}
.pg-btns button{border:none;font-family:"Anton",sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;font-size:18px;padding:18px 30px;min-height:58px;transition:.2s}
.pg-btns button:active{transform:scale(.95)}
#celebrateBtn{background:var(--hot);color:#fff;animation:pulseRing 1.9s ease-out infinite}
#celebrateBtn:hover{transform:translateY(-3px) rotate(-1deg)}
#resetArt{background:#241207;color:#fff}
#resetArt:hover{transform:translateY(-3px) rotate(1deg)}
#artMsg{font-family:"Caveat",cursive;font-size:27px;color:#c22573;padding:18px 22px 0;min-height:38px}
@media(max-width:760px){.playground .pg-head p.mono{text-align:left}}

/* ============ 5 · FIND US ============ */
.findus{background:var(--black);position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:90px 0 110px}
.findus .warp-obj{position:absolute;right:-14vw;top:4%;width:64vw;max-width:820px;opacity:.95;animation:hueDrift 12s ease-in-out infinite}
.findus .fu-in{position:relative;z-index:2;padding:0 22px}
.findus .fu-find{font-size:clamp(90px,20vw,300px);color:#4A2C6B;line-height:.86}
.findus .fu-find .us{color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:3px #FF5D8F}
.findus .fu-sub{font-family:"Space Mono",monospace;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.3em;color:#FF5D8F;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:14px}
.fu-list{margin-top:74px;display:grid;gap:64px;max-width:640px}
.fu-item .mono.idx{color:#FF5D8F;font-size:12px}
.fu-item h3{font-family:"Oswald",sans-serif;font-weight:300;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:clamp(26px,3.6vw,40px);letter-spacing:.05em;color:#4A2C6B;margin:8px 0 8px}
.fu-item p{font-family:"Space Mono",monospace;font-size:12px;line-height:2.05;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim);max-width:520px}
.fu-item p b{color:#4A2C6B}

/* ============ 6 · FOOTER ============ */
.foot-photo{position:relative;min-height:88svh;overflow:hidden}
.foot-photo .bgimg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;animation:zoomPulse 14s ease-in-out infinite}
.foot-photo .shade{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,rgba(0,0,0,.42),rgba(0,0,0,.06) 34%,rgba(0,0,0,.1) 62%,rgba(0,0,0,.55))}
.foot-photo .corner{position:absolute;z-index:3;font-family:"Space Mono",monospace;font-size:clamp(10.5px,1.3vw,13.5px);letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#fff;line-height:2;text-shadow:0 2px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.foot-photo .tl{top:24px;left:22px}
.foot-photo .tr{top:24px;right:22px;text-align:right}
.foot-photo .bl{bottom:24px;left:22px}
.foot-photo .br{bottom:24px;right:22px;text-align:right}
.foot-photo .corner b{color:var(--yellow)}
.foot-photo .ftr-big{position:absolute;z-index:2;left:0;right:0;top:50%;translate:0 -50%;text-align:center;font-size:clamp(52px,12.5vw,190px);color:#fff;text-shadow:0 16px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.55)}
.foot-photo .ftr-big .outw{color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:2.5px #fff}
.foot-photo .ftr-logo{position:absolute;z-index:3;left:50%;bottom:86px;translate:-50% 0;width:84px;height:84px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;animation:spinSlow 26s linear infinite}
.legalbar{background:#4A2C6B;color:#FFE0EC;font-family:"Space Mono",monospace;font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:14px 22px}
.legalbar b{color:#FFE066}

/* fixed confetti + fx */
#confettiBtn{position:fixed;right:16px;bottom:16px;z-index:60;background:var(--yellow);color:#4A2C6B;border:none;font-family:"Anton",sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.05em;padding:15px 22px;min-height:52px;box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.55);animation:bounceSoft 2.4s infinite}
#confettiBtn:hover{animation:jelly .7s infinite}
.balloon{position:fixed;bottom:-90px;z-index:55;font-size:44px;pointer-events:none;animation:balloonUp linear forwards}
#fx{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:80}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){*,*::before,*::after{animation-duration:.01ms!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important;transition-duration:.01ms!important}.reveal{opacity:1!important}}
/* ===== PLAY ZONE ===== */
.playzone{background:#FFF7FB;color:#3D235E;overflow:hidden}
.pz-head{padding:64px 22px 10px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.pz-head h2{font-size:clamp(56px,11vw,150px);color:#4A2C6B;line-height:.9}
.pz-head h2 .pz-out{color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:3px #FF5D8F;display:block}
.pz-stars{background:#FFE066;color:#4A2C6B;font-family:"Baloo 2",cursive;font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(20px,3vw,30px);padding:16px 24px;border-radius:999px;box-shadow:0 10px 0 #FFB6D9}
.pz-sub{font-family:"Space Mono",monospace;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:0 22px 28px;color:#7A6A9A;line-height:2}
.gamerow{width:100%;border:none;text-align:left;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;padding:26px 22px;min-height:104px;color:#3D235E;transition:.15s;cursor:pointer}
.gamerow:hover{filter:brightness(1.05)}
.gamerow:active{transform:scale(.99)}
.gamerow .num{font-family:"Space Mono",monospace;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;opacity:.7;min-width:38px}
.gamerow .gname{font-family:"Anton",sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:clamp(30px,6.5vw,72px);line-height:.95;flex:1}
.gamerow .gdesc{font-family:"Space Mono",monospace;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;max-width:220px;line-height:1.7;opacity:.85}
.gamerow .playword{font-family:"Baloo 2",cursive;font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(22px,4vw,38px);background:#fff;color:#FF5D8F;padding:12px 22px;border-radius:999px;box-shadow:0 6px 0 rgba(74,44,107,.25);white-space:nowrap}
@media(max-width:640px){.gamerow .gdesc{display:none}.gamerow{padding:20px 14px;gap:10px}}
/* overlay */
#gameOverlay{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:200;background:#FFF7FB;color:#3D235E;display:none;flex-direction:column}
#gameOverlay.open{display:flex}
.go-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:14px 16px;background:#FFB6D9}
.go-top h3{font-family:"Baloo 2",cursive;font-size:clamp(20px,4vw,30px);flex:1;color:#4A2C6B}
.go-close{background:#4A2C6B;color:#fff;border:none;width:60px;height:60px;border-radius:50%;font-size:30px;font-weight:800;flex:none}
.go-score{font-family:"Baloo 2",cursive;font-weight:800;background:#FFE066;padding:10px 16px;border-radius:999px;font-size:18px;white-space:nowrap}
#gameBody{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:20px 16px 30px;text-align:center;position:relative}
.go-foot{padding:12px 16px;background:#EFE6FF;display:flex;gap:12px;justify-content:center}
.go-again{background:#FF5D8F;color:#fff;border:none;font-family:"Baloo 2",cursive;font-weight:800;font-size:20px;padding:16px 30px;border-radius:999px;min-height:60px}
.g-inst{font-family:"Baloo 2",cursive;font-size:clamp(20px,4vw,26px);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:16px;color:#4A2C6B}
.g-msg{font-family:"Baloo 2",cursive;font-size:22px;font-weight:800;min-height:32px;margin:12px 0;color:#FF5D8F}
.g-grid{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;justify-content:center;max-width:640px;margin:0 auto}
.g-opt{background:#fff;border:4px solid #CDB4F0;border-radius:24px;min-width:84px;min-height:84px;font-size:44px;padding:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;font-family:"Baloo 2",cursive;font-weight:800;color:#4A2C6B}
.g-opt:active{transform:scale(.93)}
.g-opt.good{border-color:#58CC7A;background:#DFF7E6}
.g-opt.bad{border-color:#FF6B6B;background:#FFE1E1}
.g-col{width:76px;height:76px;border-radius:50%;border:5px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.2);cursor:pointer}
.g-big{font-size:clamp(70px,18vw,120px);line-height:1.2}
.g-word{font-family:"Baloo 2",cursive;font-size:clamp(28px,7vw,44px);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.08em}
.memgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:10px;max-width:420px;margin:0 auto}
.memcard{aspect-ratio:1;border:none;border-radius:20px;background:#CDB4F0;font-size:38px;cursor:pointer}
.memcard.open{background:#fff;border:4px solid #FFB6D9}
.catchbox{position:relative;height:340px;background:linear-gradient(#DFF3FF,#FFF0F6);border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden;max-width:560px;margin:0 auto}
.basket{position:absolute;bottom:6px;font-size:52px;transition:left .15s;transform:translateX(-50%)}
.faller{position:absolute;font-size:40px;transform:translateX(-50%)}
.arrowrow{display:flex;gap:12px;justify-content:center;margin-top:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.arrowbtn{background:#4A2C6B;color:#fff;border:none;width:64px;height:64px;border-radius:50%;font-size:28px}
.popitem{position:absolute;border:none;background:transparent;font-size:46px;cursor:pointer;animation:floatY 2s ease-in-out infinite}
.holegrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;max-width:360px;margin:0 auto}
.hole{height:96px;border-radius:50%;background:#B5EAD7;border:none;font-size:50px;cursor:pointer}
.ttt{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,92px);gap:10px;justify-content:center}
.ttt button{height:92px;font-size:52px;border:none;border-radius:20px;background:#fff;border:4px solid #A8D8EA;font-family:"Baloo 2",cursive;font-weight:800;color:#4A2C6B}
.simon{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;max-width:320px;margin:0 auto}
.simon button{height:120px;border:none;border-radius:28px;opacity:.55;cursor:pointer}
.simon button.lit{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.05)}
.mazegrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,58px);gap:6px;justify-content:center}
.mazecell{height:58px;border-radius:14px;background:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:32px}
.mazecell.wall{background:#CDB4F0}
.diffscene{display:flex;gap:14px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.diffbox{background:#fff;border:4px solid #FFC8A2;border-radius:20px;padding:14px;font-size:38px;line-height:1.5;max-width:250px}
.diffbox button{background:none;border:none;font-size:38px;cursor:pointer;padding:2px}
.puzgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,88px);gap:8px;justify-content:center}
.puzgrid button{height:88px;border:none;border-radius:18px;background:#FFB6D9;font-size:40px;cursor:pointer}
.puzgrid button.empty{background:#EFE6FF}
#drawCanvas{background:#fff;border:4px solid #CDB4F0;border-radius:20px;touch-action:none;max-width:100%}
.stampfall{position:absolute;font-size:34px;pointer-events:none;animation:fallEmoji 1.6s linear forwards}
@keyframes fallEmoji{to{transform:translateY(90vh) rotate(200deg);opacity:0}}

</style>
</head>
